# THERE IS NO /bin/uname, AND ADDING ONE WOULD NOT WORK.  Recorded here because
# a symlink for it was added for RUNSHEET K5 and then removed, and neither step
# wrote down why -- notes/kernel-build.md sec 9 still carries the fossil, a
# sentence that says both "there is no symlink of mine left" and "it is declared
# as mine".  量 2026-08-29, this unit's own busybox under qemu-mips-static:
# `busybox uname -a` -> `uname: applet not found`.  The binary lists 50 applets
# and uname is not one of them, so the symlink would have exec'd busybox as
# `uname` and busybox would have refused.  K5 reads /proc/version instead, which
# prints linux_banner verbatim and therefore carries (user@host) and the gcc
# version that `uname -a` drops.  notes/kernel-build.md sec 12.7.
# /bin/dmesg was here, tagged `unit`, until 2026-08-28, and the adversarial pass
# found it. It is NOT in this unit's dump -- the dump has 50 busybox symlinks and
# that is not one of them -- and the byte string `dmesg` does not appear in this
# busybox at all, so the applet is not compiled in either. It was removed rather
# than retagged: an entry that adds nothing and was wrong about its own
# provenance is not worth a line. It got in because the `unit` tag was checked
# for `file` entries only, and 15 of the 31 entries were `slink`.
slink

# --- one symlink that is MINE, and the reason it has to be ---
# /bin/uname was here too, and the adversarial pass killed it with the same
# instrument that killed /bin/dmesg. The note said "the applet IS in the binary
# (量: the string is present)" -- that was a `strings` FALSE POSITIVE, and
# `notes/rootfs-census.md` already documents the mirror of it. 量: busybox's
# applet-name table is at file offset 266740 and holds exactly 50 names, which are
# exactly the 50 symlinks in the dump; `uname` is not among them. The single
# `uname` hit in the file is at offset 9040, between `unsetenv` and `getpagesize`
# -- it is `.dynstr`, the uClibc syscall wrapper's symbol name. So `uname -a`
# would have returned `uname: applet not found`, exit 127, and RUNSHEET K5 would
# have read that as a shell that does not work. Removed. **K5 needs a different
# command**, and with CONFIG_PRINTK off `cat /proc/version` is now the only place
# the build stamp can be read at all -- that is R3-6's to settle.
# --- without this, init runs with no stdio and it reads exactly like a hang ---
nod

column1: # --- R3-9's second path to the flash, and it is NOT /dev/mtd0 ----------------
# 🔴 THE STEP ASKED FOR `/dev/mtd0` AND THAT CANNOT WORK ON THIS KERNEL. 量
# 2026-08-30, two routes with a control on each: 讀 both built .configs say
# `# CONFIG_MTD_CHAR is not set` (control: 9 other ^CONFIG_MTD lines in the same
# file), and 量 both System.maps hold ZERO mtdchar symbols against SIX
# mtdblock/mtdcore ones. Major 90 has no chrdev here, so `/dev/mtd0` opens
# ENODEV and `wc -c < /dev/mtd0` reads a refusal, not a size.
# 🔴 AND `/dev/mtdblock0` IS NOT THE SUBSTITUTION EITHER. mtd0 is
# `boot+cfg+linux` 0x000000-0x130000 (讀 bench/2026-08-30b/L3.log:113), which
# contains BOTH regions CLAUDE.md forbids writing. mtdblock has a write path,
# and 0400 is not a control -- root ignores DAC, so `echo x > /dev/mtdblock0`
# is one typo from an erase-block write at offset 0 on a device with no spare.
# mtd1 runs the identical mtdblock_readsect -> part_read -> rtl819x_flash read
# path, so it buys the same reading and leaves no writable node over the loader
# or H601. THE CONTROL IS THE ABSENCE OF A NODE, NOT THE MODE BITS.
# What it buys: `wc -c < /dev/mtdblock1` -> **2949120** (量 L3.log:114, and 讀
# rtl819x_flash.c with CONFIG_RTL_ROOT_IMAGE_OFFSET=0x130000 and WINDOW_SIZE
# 0x400000: 0x400000-0x130000 = 0x2D0000. Two sources; the first draft of
# this line said 2818048, which is 0x2B0000 and is a subtraction error), a readability-and-size reading through MY OWN MTD stack.
# NOT a content check: 量, this unit's busybox has none of dd/md5sum/od/hexdump/
# cmp/cksum/sum/sha1sum among its fifty applets, and a foreign binary would
# break Decision B's third leg. `cat /proc/mtd` is the free companion and reads
# ZERO flash bytes -- it prints the map from my own driver (mtd_read_proc IS in
# both System.maps).
# Refuted by: `wc` printing anything but 2949120; `No such device` (the block
# driver did not register); or a hang (the SPI read path does not complete).
# 🔴 THIS LINE IS AHEAD OF EVERY BUILT ARTEFACT. It is in no image that exists
# on 2026-08-30, and specifically NOT in
# `rlxfw-quietm-20260830.bin`, which is what
# `bench/2026-08-30c/PREDICTIONS-B5-block2.md` uploads. That card's `V-0t` and
# `V-2c` read `0x805FABF0` because they know where THAT image's `image_end`
# sits, so a rebuild moves them. The card's own pre-flight sha256 is the
# authority for that seating; this node lands on the build after it.
nod
